        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GuestCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_GuestCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down room-service order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Preparation_Split" name="Start preparation"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" name="Order includes wine or other alcohol?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" name="Alcohol handled"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Preparation_Join" name="Food, wine and cart ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverToRoom" name="Deliver food, wine and cart to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Merge" name="Ready to bill"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Split" name="Waiter has another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleOtherOrder" name="Prepare or deliver other order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Room-service order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_GuestCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicketToKitchen" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_Preparation_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Preparation_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Preparation_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Preparation_Split" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Preparation_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alcohol_Yes" name="Order includes wine or other alcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${alcoholOrdered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" name="No alcohol ordered" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_FetchWineAndAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Preparation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Preparation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_Preparation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_Preparation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Preparation_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverToRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" name="No other order pending" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Split" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOrderPending" name="Other order pending" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Split" targetRef="Task_HandleOtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${otherOrderPending}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_HandleOtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
